name: Flat-hole cutting tool for clock pivot bushing repair

mentions.name: Flat-hole cutting tool for clock pivot bushing repair
mentions.description: A cutting tool for an electric hand drill that makes flat holes in wood cut to exact depth and centered correctly, used to prepare worn out pivot holes in 19th century wooden works clocks for inserting bushes. Built as a way to learn to use a newly purchased micro-mill.
mentions.problem: Worn out pivot holes in 19th century wooden works clocks need to be prepared to insert bushes.
mentions.source_excerpt: by creating a cutting tool for an electric hand drill that will make flat holes in wood that are cut to exact depth and centered correctly.  This is for preparing worn out pivot holes in 19th century wooden works clocks to insert bushes.
